text:
Title is in the friend only. The condition “if the property shall ever be used for church purposes” creates a shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach age 25, but because the sister had no children at the time of the conveyance and the class remains open, no child has yet vested. Therefore, the friend holds a fee simple subject to executory limitation, with the executory interest in the unborn or unvested class.

CONFIDENCE: 85
